Shandesh - Odhwa Bjang feat. King Salah (Performance Video)
Watch the performance video for “Odhwa Bjang” by Shandesh featuring King Salah, taken from the For The Queens EP.
“Odhwa Bjang” showcases Shandesh’s performance style and Lekompo sound, bringing the song to life through a focused visual performance alongside King Salah.
Taken from the For The Queens EP, the track adds another standout moment to the project and connects with fans of Shandesh, Lekompo and contemporary South African music.
Thank you for watching “Odhwa Bjang”.
